state_meaning: AI-drafted candidate; no person has reviewed it.
text: The paper reports that CriticGPT models trained only on critique comparisons of unmodified code, without the tampering step, severely under-performed on both inserted and detected bugs according to automated GPT-4 evaluations, and no human evaluations of them are presented. The authors suspect lower inter-annotator agreement without reference bugs produced a worse reward model.
title: Critics trained without tampered-bug data severely underperform
